paper_title: Search for Dark Matter Axions with CAST-CAPP
notes: CAST-CAPP haloscope, 19.74-22.47 ueV (4.774-5.434 GHz). Best exclusion g_agamma = 8e-14 GeV^-1 at 90% CL, with typical values around 1e-13 across the range; better sensitivity near 22 ueV due to phase-matching. Exact per-mass curve is from Fig. 5 (only endpoints/best value given numerically in text); intermediate points approximate.
